dog.description_text:
He’s learning that being kind takes just as much strength as being tough. When someone gives him a chance, Spike proves himself to be dependable, thoughtful, playful and surprisingly gentle. Spike does need to be the only dog in the home. Beneath the nickname and the rough edges is a pooch who wants to belong, do the right thing, and be the best companion ever. Spike loves belly rubs, treats and running around the playpen chasing his favorite toys.

This animal is located at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. We are open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age appropriate shots. Apply for Adoption Today!
dog.name: Spike
